sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232140 (facility, rates and campsite catalog via the public API, read 2026-11-23)
Esri World Imagery 44.2578,-71.5035 (500 m square, catalog site points overlaid)

sites.source: FS page ('It has 32 sites'); recreation.gov catalog: 20 reservable sites, 14 STANDARD NONELECTRIC (max length 30 ft on 013-016, 018-020, 022; 25 ft on 001-004, 025; 20 ft on 023) and 6 tent-only; 13 take 23 ft+

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov ('Accessible restrooms and a hand pump for water are provided. There is no dump station, and the nearest showers are 10 miles away')

values.note: The Forest Service gives mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov's 2026 fee season ran May 22 to October 11.

season.source: FS page ('Seasons of Use Mid-May to Mid-October'); recreation.gov rate season 2026-05-22 to 2026-10-11, 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11

booking.source: FS page ('Some sites can be reserved online ... Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'); recreation.gov catalog lists 20 site-specific reservable sites of 32

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $24 per night / Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); recreation.gov 2026 and 2027 rates $24 for every site type; 'Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle'

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: Wooded sites around a large loop off Zealand Road, a short walk from the Ammonoosuc River; some sit on a ridge with mountain views, and there is a grassy field. Showers are about 10 miles away. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov catalog/rates: 32 sites (20 reservable, rest first-come), 13 take 23 ft+ (max 30), no hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no dump/showers, $24 + $6 extra vehicle, mid-May to mid-October. Not waterfront (river ~90 m+ through forest). Pin on the loop.
flags: Waterfront: not waterfront stays. The nearest catalog sites (13, 20) are ~90 m+ from the river through closed forest canopy on Esri imagery.
Rig length: 13 of 20 reservable sites take 23 ft+ (30 ft on 8, 25 ft on 5). Real per-site values.
